en: Kenaciviññeyyaduka (The Dyad on Cognizable by Someone)
Dependent on a state cognizable by one [person], a state cognizable by another arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state cognizable by one, a state not cognizable by another arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state cognizable by one, states both cognizable by that same person and not cognizable by that person arise by way of root condition.
They arise by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state cognizable by some [consciousness] but not by others, a state cognizable by some [consciousness] but not by others arises by way of the root condition… three.

Dependent on a state both cognizable by some [consciousness] and cognizable by others, a state cognizable by some [consciousness] but not by others arises by way of the root condition… three. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root-cause condition, there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, there are nine. (The detailed exposition applies everywhere.
The Minor Intermediate Couplets are completed.
